# Filter messages to this week's Splitwise invitations
from datetime import datetime, timedelta

# Current date: May 18, 2023 (Thursday)
current_date = datetime(2023, 5, 18)
# Start of week (Monday)
start_of_week = current_date - timedelta(days=current_date.weekday())  # Monday
end_of_week = start_of_week + timedelta(days=6)  # Sunday

print("Week range:", start_of_week.date(), "to", end_of_week.date())

# Filter messages that are splitwise invitations and within this week
invitations_this_week = []
for msg in messages:
    if "splitwise group invitation" in msg["message"].lower():
        sent_at = datetime.fromisoformat(msg["sent_at"])
        if start_of_week <= sent_at <= end_of_week:
            invitations_this_week.append(msg)

print(f"Found {len(invitations_this_week)} invitations this week")
for inv in invitations_this_week:
    print(inv["text_message_id"], inv["sender"]["name"], inv["sender"]["contact_id"], inv["sent_at"], inv["message"])
